activityinterface.field.description: One `with:` key: `type`, `required` and a documentary `default` — the vocabulary an Orkflow's `inputs:` has, and not one word more — and a `description`, which packs into the `org.orkstack.activity.docs` label instead.

default.description: Documentary: what the image assumes when the key is absent. Never written into `with:`; not null, and of the declared type.

description.description: What this key means: one paragraph of plain text, `code` in backticks; packed into the `org.orkstack.activity.docs` label.

required.description: The image refuses to run without this key. A key with a default is never required.

type.description: One of string, number, boolean, object, array, or several joined by `|`.

activityinterface.op.description: One op: what it does, and the keys it reads beside `fields`.

description.description: What this op does: one paragraph of plain text, `code` in backticks; packed into the `org.orkstack.activity.docs` label.

fields.description: The keys this op reads in addition to `fields`; a key is declared once, shared or under an op.

description: An image's `with:` contract (kind: ActivityInterface, docs/ACTIVITY_IMAGES.md): `orkctl activity interface pack` packs it into the image's `org.orkstack.activity.interface` label, which the engine reads.

defaultOp.description: The op the image runs when `op` is absent; with `ops` and no `defaultOp`, `op` is required.

description.description: What the activity does: one paragraph of plain text, `code` in backticks; packed into the `org.orkstack.activity.docs` label.

fields.description: The top-level `with:` keys every op reads (for an image with no `op`, the whole `with:` block).

icon.description: The image's icon: one SVG on viewBox="0 0 16 16" of path, circle, ellipse, rect, line, polyline, polygon and g, drawn in currentColor, at most 2048 bytes; packed into the `org.orkstack.activity.icon` label. Clients draw a default icon for an image without one.

kind.description: Exactly `ActivityInterface`: an image's `with:` contract, packed into its `org.orkstack.activity.interface` label at build time.

ops.description: The image follows the `op` convention: each op's name, and the keys it reads beside `fields`. `op` is then implied and must not appear in `fields`.

values.description: Documentary: the keys the image writes to `values.json`.
